defs.def: to accept that sth is true 承认（属实）

ex.s: Your sister is a good swimmer;surely you will be, too. ”What she refused to acknowledge, however, was that I was visibly afraid of water.
ex.t: 如果有空位，你可以注册。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 有时设备失败是因为一个好的设计使用了低质量材料且施工不当。

ex.s: To acknowledge the support of his teacher.

defs.def: to accept that sb/sth has a particular authority or status 承认（权威、地位）

ex.s: What I really admire is the way she has acknowledged that good health not only makes us more beautiful, but happier, too!
ex.t: 我真正钦佩的是，她承认身体健康不仅让我们更美丽，而且让我们更快乐！

ex.s: However, Tu Youyou would not acknowledge defeat.
He was not willing to acknowledge defeat.
The first time that she had to write an essay, her tutor explained that she must acknowledge what other people had said if she cited their ideas, but that he mainly wanted to know what she thought!
ex.t: 她第一次写文章时，她的导师解释说，如果她引用别人的想法，她必须承认他们说的话，但他主要想知道她的想法！

ex.s: E that I don’t know how to acknowledge all the sources in my research paper correctly.
ex.t: 我不知道如何正确地确认我的研究论文中的所有来源。

defs.def: to tell sb that you have received sth that they sent to you 告知收悉
to show that you have noticed sb/sth by smiling, waving, etc. （微笑、挥手等）致意
to publicly express thanks for help you have been given （公开）感谢
